title: Jazzy Snappy Oaxacan Portobello Mushrooms Fajitas
description: A lazy Sunday Mexican dish featuring dark soft brown sugar and snappy portobello mushrooms, served in a ssam-wrap style fajita, perfect for an ovo-vegetarian friendly meal.

ingredients.name: Portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stems removed and caps sliced into thin strips

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add sliced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 4 minutes.
Add sliced portobello mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add dark brown sugar, fajita seasoning, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Continue to cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble fajitas by placing a portion of the mushroom and vegetable mixture onto a tortilla and topping with shredded cheese.
